title: CDOT TDM Strategy
description: One TDM strategy record. One YAML file per strategy in strategy-catalog/strategies/. This file is the source of truth that the calculator app consumes (after compilation to strategies.json by build.py).

id.description: Stable snake_case key. MUST match the StrategyKey used by the app (app/src/strategies/strategies.ts) for implemented strategies. Never rename once published.

uid.description: Stable human-facing identifier, e.g. TR-01, LU-03. Two-three letter category prefix + zero-padded number.

name.description: Display name shown in the picker and detail header.

category.description: Category id. Must exist in globals.yaml -> categories[].id.

status.description: implemented = live in the app with a calc fn; planned = catalogued but not yet built; not_recommended = quantification not recommended (Handy et al. 2025 etc.).

tags.description: Filtering tags. Values should come from globals.yaml -> tag_catalog. Enhancement: tagging & filtering.

short_description.description: 1-2 sentence summary shown on the strategy card and detail header.

extended_description.description: Markdown. 2-3 paragraph narrative (FHU). May reference images. Empty string = not yet written.

images.description: Illustrative images/diagrams. Files live in strategy-catalog/images/. If empty, the app falls back to the category image (globals.yaml -> categories[].image).

method.description: Short methodology label, e.g. 'CAPCOA LUT-4'. Shown under the detail header.

methodology_detail.description: Markdown. The full methodology write-up for the accordion + methods page: the prose explanation of the method, the elasticities/effect sizes and where they come from, plus citations and source links written inline as Markdown (e.g. [CAPCOA Handbook](https://...)).

guidance.description: Markdown. "When to use this strategy" copy shown in the Applicability section. Split out of extended_description (the former '**Guidance:** …' paragraph). May include a relative hash cross-link to a related strategy, e.g. [Name](#/strategies/other_id).

auto_filled_summary.description: Human-readable list of context values filled automatically from the selected TAZs (e.g. ['mode share','vehicle occupancy','baseline VMT']). Feeds the 'filled automatically' reassurance line in the What-you'll-need checklist.

applicability.description: Where the strategy is valid. The app warns (or filters) when a selected project area does not meet these thresholds. Enhancement: minimum densities + recommended-for-you.

area_types.description: Area types where the strategy is recommended. Empty = all.

warn_message.description: Message shown when thresholds are not met.

inputs.description: User-supplied inputs rendered in the Configure section.

key.description: Argument name passed to the calc fn.

scale.description: slider: display = stored * scale (e.g. 100 for a '%' suffix). Default 1.

default.description: Stored in the unit the calc fn expects (fractions for %, miles for distance).

tooltip.description: Short one-line hint shown in the (i) tooltip.

instructions.description: Markdown/HTML. A paragraph on how the user finds or determines this value (SR). Empty = not yet written.

benchmark.description: Optional contextual benchmark text (e.g. peer-city values).

prepopulated_from.description: Optional: TAZ data field that seeds this input's baseline value.

prerequisite.description: True when the user must gather this value ahead of time; drives the 'What you'll need' checklist.

summary.description: Short, plain (non-markdown) one-liner for the checklist card, distinct from the longer `instructions`.

source_note.description: For a prerequisite input with no resource link: the 'Source: …' provenance line (e.g. 'your project scope / agency service plan').

resources.description: Structured reference links, rendered as buttons in the checklist and the always-open help block.

notes.description: Internal notes for editors; not surfaced in the app.

compute.description: Closed-form math, authored once in YAML and evaluated identically by scripts/strategy_compute.py (analysis) and app/src/strategies/computeDsl.ts (app) — no hand-written calc function. Strategies WITHOUT this block fall back to the code-side STRATEGY_REGISTRY (used for complex/spatial methods that can't be expressed as a formula). Sign convention: the formula returns pct_vmt_reduction, negative = reduction.

pool.description: Base-VMT trip pool the reduction applies to.

const.description: Named numeric constants available to every expression (cite the source in methodology_detail).

row_defaults.description: Fallback values for per-TAZ row fields the formula reads that may be absent from the app's TAZ layer (e.g. transit_vrh). Applied below the actual row value, so present data always wins.

let.description: Ordered intermediate bindings; each item is a single-key { name: expression } map. Later bindings may reference earlier ones.

formula.description: Final expression -> pct_vmt_reduction. Grammar: + - * / , comparisons, and/or/not, and clamp/min/max/mean/abs/if(); operands are const/row_defaults/row/params/let names.
